name: Artificial Fashionista
source:
Foris is a social media influencer that finds herself in a somewhat unique situation: She's stuck in a [s]death game[/s] rehabilitation program with 13 [s]criminals[/s] other young people!

On a whim, she was given a rare opportunity, though: She can redeem herself by completing her captor's fashion challenges!

Help Foris sweet-talk the other participants into giving her more clothes, put together fashionable outfits, and impress her hosts — for a chance to regain access to the outside world!

[From [url=https://kigyo.itch.io/artificial-fashionista]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Foris是一位社交媒体影响者，她发现自己处于一个有点独特的境地：她与13名[s]罪犯[/s]其他年轻人一起陷入[s]死亡游戏[/s]康复计划！

然而，她一时兴起，得到了一个难得的机会：她可以通过完成绑架者的时尚挑战来救赎自己！

帮助福里斯甜言蜜语地说服其他参与者给她更多的衣服，搭配时尚的服装，并给她的主人留下深刻的印象——这样才有机会重新接触外面的世界！

[来自[url=https://kigyo.itch.io/artificial-fashionista]itch.io[/url]]
